records.failureSummary: Read-only review of the persistence and password-storage implementation (src/config/data-dir.mjs, src/storage/json-store.mjs, src/security/password.mjs, src/password-hasher.mjs, src/server.mjs, test/ac-04-persistence.test.mjs). Verified: DATA_DIR is resolved once (env value, default ./data, absolute) with mkdir -p; db.json is the single data file; writes go to a dot-prefixed sibling temp file (mode 0600, fsync attempted) then fs.rename, serialised per file path so concurrent saves cannot interleave and reload after restart recovers the same data; the password module uses scrypt with a fresh 16-byte salt per password, a self-describing scrypt$v1$N=..,r=..,p=..,k=..$salt$hash descriptor, canonical base64url validation, length-equality guard before crypto.timingSafeEqual, fail-closed false on malformed input, zeroed buffers, and error strings that contain no secret or hash; server logging is single-line JSON on stdout with only data dir path, file path and record counts, and error responses return a generic message without echoing credentials. However the AC-04 suite is still red: npm test (node --test) reports 3 tests, 0 passed, 3 failed, all failing at store-module discovery ('store module is missing; expected one of: src/store.mjs, ...'). The repository contains src/storage/json-store.mjs but no src/store.mjs facade with insertUser/getUserById/listUsers, so no persisted-user write path exists and AC-04 cannot pass. npm run lint (20 checks) and npm run typecheck (16 checks) pass. Because the required fix is new backend product code under src/, the reviewer did not modify any file (reviewers are read-only); this needs a BACKEND task.
